debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to aid troubleshooting.

runtime_dir.description: Directory where the daemon stores runtime data (e.g., PID file, sockets). Must be writable by the daemon user.

state_file.description: Path to the file used to persist window match mappings across restarts.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle window matching events concurrently.

match_timeout.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for a window match operation before timing out.

x11_enabled.description: Enable support for X11 windows (required on traditional X11 sessions).

wayland_enabled.description: Enable support for Wayland windows (required on modern Wayland sessions).

matching_rules.description: List of custom application matching rules to override default behavior.

section.description: Section header used in the config file (e.g., 'Application', 'DesktopEntry').

exec.description: Executable command or path used to identify the application.

icon.description: Optional icon name or path for the application.

regex.description: Optional regex pattern to apply for flexible matching (e.g., on window titles).

log_to_file.description: If true, log output is written to a file instead of syslog.

log_file.description: Path to the log file when logging to file is enabled.

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for logged messages.
